title: One full correlation copy: learning replays store only what they add
description: Found as F-38 (MS-2026-0008). Owner decision 2026-10-21: keep 1. Every Learn now replay starts from the designated Day-0 replay's correlation (priorHistoricalCorrelation), adds its commits, and saves the whole result again: about 11.3 MB per learning window, 52 copies so far, about 440 MB, ignored by git. Old copies cannot simply be deleted: VerifiedGenesisHistoricalCorrelationResolver loads the correlation of the replay that admitted each item, so deleting one breaks verification of everything that replay admitted (verified_genesis_historical_correlation_state_not_found).
objective: runtime-data keeps one full historical correlation, the designated replay's, and each learning replay stores only what it adds, while every admitted item still verifies.
risks: Every canonical item admitted by a learning replay must verify the same before and after; this is checked item by item against the current stores before anything is deleted.
The designated Day-0 correlation is the base for everything; it is never rewritten or deleted.
Existing full copies are deleted only after the item-by-item check passes, with the owner's approval.
